instruction: Navigate to view all available forms on the Justice Department website without filtering by division.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to general forms page without filtering. Uses simpler URL pattern to check just for /forms path.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_url_from_accessTree getter to extract the current Chrome tab URL
Metric function is_expected_url_pattern_match properly handles URL pattern matching with regex
Expected pattern 'justice\.gov/forms' accurately verifies navigation to the forms page without division-specific filtering
Complete instruction coverage: verifies both navigation to forms page AND absence of division filtering
Parameter handling is correct: metric properly accesses rules['expected'] directly when expected.type='rule'
No postconfig needed as Chrome will remain on the target page after navigation
Pattern is appropriately flexible to match various forms URLs (e.g., /forms, /forms/, /forms/list)
